Class DevClassLoader

java.lang.Object
java.lang.ClassLoader
io.micronaut.dev.loader.DevClassLoader
public final class DevClassLoader extends ClassLoader
The application's classloader for the life of the development JVM: one stable identity that delegates to the current GenerationClassLoader and is swapped to a new one when the classes change.

Delegation is parent-first, as for any loader: the libraries in the parent are never shadowed by the reloadable tier. The facade defines no class itself; a class's loader is its generation, so a retired generation's classes are recognisable and the retired generation can be collected once nothing refers to its classes any more.

Swapping generations tells the process-wide caches keyed by loader identity to forget this loader: the META-INF/micronaut service index and the shared bean introspector.

The facade is the handle for swapping and for telling a stale class; it is not the loader to give a context or a thread. The JVM records the loader Class.forName was called with as the initiating loader of the class it found, and would answer with the retired generation's class for as long as the facade lives. Each context loads through current(), the generation loader itself, which is also what the application thread has as its context loader.

Since:
5.3.0

      generationsDir - The loader's own directory for the snapshots; emptied first

    • loadClass

      protected Class<?> loadClass(String name, boolean resolve) throws ClassNotFoundException
      Loads a class parent-first, then from the current generation, without asking the JVM which classes this facade initiated: after Class.forName(name, initialize, facade) the JVM records the facade as an initiating loader of that generation's class, and ClassLoader.findLoadedClass(String) would answer with it after every later swap. Class.forName with the facade still answers from that record, which nothing clears, so name resolution goes through current().

      Parameters:
